goal.title: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Engine
goal.intent: Implement ccrystal mcp stdio JSON-RPC server with decoupled McpHandler, tools, resources, and prompts

acceptanceCriteria.description: Write failing unit tests for MCP JSON-RPC protocol models and codecs
Implement MCP protocol ADTs and JSON-RPC 2.0 Circe codecs
Write failing unit tests for McpHandler tool dispatching, resource providers, and prompts
Implement McpHandler trait and DefaultMcpHandler wired to CrystalStore and Runner
Write failing unit tests for McpTransport and StdioMcpTransport stream loop
Implement McpTransport trait and StdioMcpTransport line-delimited engine
Write failing unit tests for CLI 'ccrystal mcp' command parsing
Implement CliCommand.Mcp in CommandParser, Runner, and Main entry point
Write end-to-end integration tests simulating an MCP client session over stdio streams
Generate distribution templates for Claude Desktop and Cursor rules in docs/mcp/
Compile native CLI binary, install to ~/.local/bin, and configure local MCP client setup
Update README.md and documentation with local MCP setup and usage instructions

nodes.contentSummary: Initialized crystal 'native-mcp-server' with goal: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Engine
Phase 1 Complete: MCP Protocol models, Circe codecs, and DefaultMcpHandler implemented and verified natively
Phase 2 Complete: StdioMcpTransport line-delimited engine, CommandParser mcp subcommand, and Runner integration verified across JVM and Native

Track 8 Concluded: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Engine fully implemented, tested, verified natively, installed into ~/.local/bin/ccrystal, and registered in local MCP client configuration
